about: Jalali dates (mu-151), one set of answers for both: jalali.test.ts reads these, and mu-152's Rust port of jalali.ts reads the same file. `known` is [Jalali YYYY/MM/DD, Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD], the same day both ways; `impossible` is a Jalali YYYY/MM/DD that is no day (parseJalali says "date").
